context: Mei and Aoi chat about a holiday at a shrine.
purpose: Casual register; vocabulary (女の子/ママ/老人/休日/神様) in natural home.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 休日に、古い神社へ行ったの。
lines.en: On the holiday, I went to an old shrine.
lines.style: soft warm woman voice, gentle dreamy delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 神様に、何をお願いしたの?
lines.en: What did you wish to the gods?
lines.style: bright barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 家族の健康を、お願いしたの。
lines.en: I wished for my family's health.
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 小さな女の子も、お参りしてた?
lines.style: curious barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: うん、女の子がママと手を合わせてた。
lines.en: Yeah, a girl pressed her hands together with her mom.
lines.style: soft woman voice, gentle warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 休日の神社、静かでいいよね。
lines.en: The shrine on a holiday is nice and quiet.
lines.style: warm barista voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 優しい老人が、道を教えてくれたの。
lines.en: A kind old man showed me the way.
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 次の休日は、私も行きたいな。
lines.en: I want to go on the next holiday too.
lines.style: bubbly barista voice, soft warm cheerful closing delivery throughout
